name: domain.security_scanner
description: Static code vulnerability scanner, secret detection, and dependency audit plugin

entrypoints.name: scan_secrets
entrypoints.description: Scan text or code content for leaked API keys, tokens, private keys, and passwords

parameters.name: content
parameters.description: Source code or text content to scan

entrypoints.name: scan_code_vulnerabilities
entrypoints.description: Perform static AST and pattern analysis for security vulnerabilities (injection, eval, deserialization)

entrypoints.name: audit_dependencies
entrypoints.description: Audit a requirements.txt or dependency list against known vulnerability patterns and unpinned packages
